classClosure.reason: The matched emit is UserCorpus.refresh(), a bounded read of TopicMemory rows into local derived U records, not an external self-action. The backfill lane that calls it sends nothing, restarts or kills nothing, and is hard-bounded: at most 2 topics per 10-minute tick, at most 20 topics started per UTC day (persisted), at most 5 pages per topic per tick, a topic parked after 3 failures or 40 ticks with one report, and done topics never redone. It cannot amplify under sustained pressure: an always-failing topic yields at most 3 attempts and then stops.
